description: Appearance, evidence and solver-link records for every material usable in ArmorLab projectile designs. Appearance blocks are display conventions and never feed the solver. 'solver_material_ref' only points at the existing preset records (presets/presets.json); no numeric solver values are duplicated here.

materials.name: Hardened AP steel (German APCBC body)

evidence.summary: German APCBC bodies are described as hardened steel armour-piercing bodies (TM 9-1985-3 / OP 1666 per research pack). Exact grade and heat treatment are not documented.

materials.confidence: B for material class; grade unknown
materials.uncertainty: Steel class only. The solver values are generic/tuning estimates, not data for this shell steel.

appearance.note: Appearance only. Changing any value here never changes solver behaviour.

cutaway.note: Cutaway colour is a legend convention, not the material's natural colour.

not_simulated: fracture toughness / damage law beyond the generic critical bond strain
